requirements.claim: Pinned OBS 32.1.2 build produces an x64 plugin DLL for the release commit
Portable package contains only required runtime files, notices, and minimal documentation
Packaged approved assets match repository SHA-256 values
Final DLL loads and registers in OBS Studio 32.1.2
Aitum Multistream and Aitum Vertical load in the test host
Two newly created sources retain independent settings, timers, bindings, and hotkeys
Landscape timer follows only the main OBS stream
Vertical timer follows only the selected Aitum Vertical output
A mismatched Aitum output leaves rendering stable and recovers after the selected output becomes available
Manual start, pause, and reset affect only the intended source
F9/F10 and F11/F12 test assignments affect only their registered source
OBS WebSocket and both RTMP listeners are authenticated where applicable and loopback-only
2560x1440 layout is unclipped and legible
1440x2560 layout is unclipped and legible
Planet curve and detached floating dot remain visible
LOG, time, and date remain legible at 80 percent without bubble growth
Short, normal, and long titles size the rounded session panel without clipping or cap distortion
Settings, hotkeys, and documented timer state persist across restart
Installer deploys exact packaged files to the documented shared ProgramData OBS plugin location
Disposable Windows lifecycle test creates an uninstaller, matches installed hashes, and removes runtime files
After uninstall and OBS restart, prior scene items are unavailable/red and no overlay renders
Downloaded Actions outer ZIP contains the installer, portable ZIP, raw DLL, and checksums with verified inner hashes
Final artifact is accessible and its digest is recorded
